rows.label: bf02150100_0020
rows.name:
Was Homura born from someone too,
like that Blade we just saw...?

rows.label: bf02150100_0030
rows.name: What exactly is Heaven's Holy Grail...?

rows.label: bf02150100_0050
rows.name: Hmm... These fellows are Imperial troops.

rows.label: bf02150100_0080
rows.name:
That one is a rebel who defies the Empire,
a member of Iira, is she not?

rows.label: bf02150100_0100
rows.name:
Is that so? A Gulan Driver
accompanied by a white beast Blade...

rows.label: bf02150100_0110
rows.name:
She looks exactly like
the wanted poster!

rows.label: bf02150100_0140
rows.name: Ah, it does look like her...

rows.label: bf02150100_0160
rows.name:
N-no, that's wrong! It doesn't look like her!
Not at all!

rows.label: bf02150100_0170
rows.name: Wait, we've got no time for this!

rows.label: bf02150100_0180
rows.name: Who cares if it looks just like her?

rows.label: bf02150100_0210
rows.name:
You look like a Driver
too. Registration number?

rows.label: bf02150100_0250
rows.name:
No registration number... So you're
an unlicensed Driver, aren't you?

rows.label: bf02150100_0270
rows.name:
We're taking all of you in. Make your case
before His Excellency the Consul.

rows.label: bf02150100_0280
rows.name:
Rex, Byakko and I will make our move.
Use that chance to escape.

rows.label: bf02150100_0300
rows.name: This is a problem for Byakko and me.

rows.label: bf02150100_0310
rows.name:
He just said 'all of you.'
So we can't stay out of this.

rows.label: bf02150100_0320
rows.name: Sheesh, you're really stubborn, aren't you?

rows.label: bf02150100_0340
rows.name:
Okay, we go on three. We'll
go left, you go right.

rows.label: bf02150100_0380
rows.name:
Y-you're resisting?
Are you coming at us?

rows.label: bf02150100_0400
rows.name:
D-don't falter! There are only a few of them!
Surround them and take them in!
